meta.name: Dead Ringers
meta.description: Elliot and Beverly Mantle are twins who share everything: drugs, lovers, and an unapologetic desire to do whatever it takes — including pushing the boundaries on medical ethics — in an effort to challenge antiquated practices and bring women’s healthcare to the forefront.

videos.title: Two
videos.overview: Rebecca and Susan Parker invite the twins upstate for a dinner and a pitch.

videos.title: Three
videos.overview: It's the opening party and the twins are on a high, until a shift in Beverly's life causes Elliot to spiral.

videos.title: Four
videos.overview: It's the twins' birthday and their parents are in town for a stressful celebration.

videos.title: Five
videos.overview: The twins take a trip to open Birthing Centre Number 2 and spend the evening with Susan Parker's surprising family.

videos.title: Six
videos.overview: The Centre is thriving, and so, on the surface is Beverly. But for how long?

meta.slogan: Witness the birth of something extraordinary.
